data_size is the byte length of the packet data pck_data returned by gf_filter_pck_get_data, and is passed as the buffer length to isoffin_push_buffer.
ch->sample->dataLength is used as the allocation size for the packet and as the byte count copied from ch->sample->data into data.

values.claim: sample_dur is initialized from ch->au_duration and multiplied by ch->sample->nb_pack when nb_pack is nonzero, then used as the packet duration.
dep_flags is built by shifting left 2 and OR-ing ch->isLeading, ch->dependsOn, ch->dependedOn, and ch->redundant in that order.
subs_buf and subs_buf_size are set by gf_isom_sample_get_subsamples_buffer for the given track and sample number; when subs_buf is non-NULL, subs_buf_size is used as the property data length.
ch->sai_buffer_size is asserted nonzero and used as the data length for the CENC SAI property when ch->sai_buffer is set and the packet is encrypted.
traf_start is 2 if finfo.seg_start_plus_one is nonzero, otherwise 1.
start is set to finfo.frag_start, then overwritten to finfo.seg_start_plus_one-1 when finfo.seg_start_plus_one is nonzero.

values.claim: nb_forced_end counts channels that are not playing or are forced-end; when check_forced_end is true and nb_forced_end equals count, the input is stopped.
nb_pck is initialized to 50 and decremented after each successfully sent sample, bounding the inner loop to at most 50 iterations per channel.
For audio streams, ch->sample_num is compared to gf_isom_get_sample_count(read->mov, ch->track) to detect the end range.
In debug logging, ch->sample_num and gf_isom_get_sample_count(ch->owner->mov, ch->track) are logged as current and new sample counts.

values.claim: ch->check_has_rap is cleared and ch->has_rap set when gf_isom_get_sample_count(ch->owner->mov, ch->track) is greater than 1 and gf_isom_has_sync_points(ch->owner->mov, ch->track) equals 1.
When read->mem_load_mode==2 and not read->force_fetch, fetch_input is set false if read->mem_blob.size is greater than read->mstore_size.

executions.claim: If read->in_error is nonzero, the function returns immediately with that error; no further processing occurs.
executions.evidence:
L11: if (read->in_error)
L12: return read->in_error;

executions.claim: When read->pid is set and the init segment failed during a DASH switch (not partial download, not mem_load_mode, moov_not_loaded==2), isoffin_configure_pid is called; if moov_not_loaded remains nonzero afterward, the function returns GF_OK.
In mem_load_mode==2, fetch_input is set to GF_FALSE only when force_fetch is false and mem_blob.size > mstore_size; force_fetch is then cleared.
If no packet is available and wait_for_source is true, the function returns GF_EOS when the pid is at EOS, otherwise GF_OK; otherwise it breaks out of the fetch loop.
When a packet is obtained, if mem_load_mode is set the packet data is pushed to the buffer; otherwise if moov_not_loaded==2 the packet is dropped and the function returns GF_OK.
After dropping a packet and setting has_new_data, if read->in_error is set the function returns that error.
After the fetch loop, in_is_eos is set true if the pid is at EOS, if input_is_stop was set, or if frag_type is unset and input_loaded is true.

If invalid_segment is set and in_is_eos is false, the function returns GF_OK; otherwise it clears invalid_segment, sends EOS on all playing channels that have not sent EOS, sets eos_signaled, and returns GF_EOS.
If read->pid is not set but read->extern_mov is set, in_is_eos and input_loaded are both set true.
If moov_not_loaded==1, the function returns GF_OK when mem_load_mode is set; otherwise it clears moov_not_loaded and returns the result of isoffin_setup.

When refresh_fragmented is set, it is cleared if in_is_eos or if the FILE_CACHED property is true; if has_new_data, gf_isom_refresh_fragmented is called and refresh_fragmented is cleared on error other than GF_ISOM_INCOMPLETE_FILE or when frag_type is unset.
The channel loop iterates i from 0 to count-1; channels not playing increment nb_forced_end and are skipped.
If a channel has not sent EOS, is_active is set true.
executions.evidence:
L154: if (!ch->eos_sent)
L155: is_active = GF_TRUE;

executions.claim: The inner sample loop runs while nb_pck is nonzero; it breaks if full_segment_flush is unset and the channel pid would block.
If read->stsd is set and the channel's last_sample_desc_index differs from it and a sample exists, the sample is released and the loop continues without decrementing nb_pck.
If a sample exists, a packet is allocated (or a shared null packet if read->nodata); allocation failure returns GF_OUT_OF_MEM.

If no sample exists and last_state is GF_EOS, then if playing==2 and in_is_eos the channel is stopped, else nb_forced_end is incremented and check_forced_end set; if in_is_eos and EOS not sent, EOS is sent and the loop breaks.
If no sample exists and last_state is not GF_EOS, force_fetch is set true and the loop breaks.
After each channel, min_offset_plus_one is updated to 1 + last_valid_sample_data_offset if it is zero or greater than that offset.
